service_name.description: Name of the supervised service; used to identify logs and generate tag names.

rotate_enabled.description: Enable log rotation: keep a fixed number of files with max size and compression.

sync_enabled.description: Enable synchronous writes to disk after each line (slower, safer).

use_iso8601.description: Use ISO8601 timestamps (e.g., 2024-06-15T10:22:33.123456+02:00); otherwise use Unix epoch seconds.

tag_enabled.description: Prepend each log line with a tag (derived from the service name) for source identification.

dedup_enabled.description: Drop duplicate consecutive lines (useful to suppress repeated warnings or errors).

filter_patterns.description: List of regex patterns to filter log lines. Each pattern specifies how lines are matched and included/excluded.

regex.description: Perl-compatible regex to match log lines. Use empty string for a no-op (skip filter).

mode.description: Whether to keep ('include') or drop ('exclude') lines matching the pattern.
